handoff.summary: Cycle 7 completed T-011: phase4-scenario done. Scenario persistence ships at both layers: src/domain/scenarioCodec.ts (versioned format 'consensus-sim.scenario' v1: {format, version, config incl. seed, runSlot, interventions}; parseScenario fully validates the tagged union and rejects unknown kinds / out-of-range validators / bad slot spans), src/ui/scenarioStore.ts (localStorage list under key consensus-sim.scenarios; corrupt entries dropped silently), src/ui/ScenarioPanel.tsx (保存 / 読込・再実行 / 削除 + JSON エクスポート/インポート), useSimulation.loadScenario(scenario, runSlot) = deterministic replay via scenarioStates with cursor on the saved slot. App clamps selectedValidator when a smaller validatorCount loads. Evidence green: typecheck 0, vitest 13 files / 120 tests 0 (23 codec + 3 DOM scenario tests incl. save->mutate->reload exact reproduction), build 0. changed_files 34 > reset threshold 25: a context reset is expected — this handoff is written for a fresh session reading only the disk. Musts remaining: T-012, T-013 (both phase5-polish, costs 4+2 = one batch).
next_actions: T-012 (phase5-polish, cost 4): no-manual operability pass (success criteria 5/8: every scenario operation discoverable and executable from the UI alone, each step's state change readable). Walk the whole flow as a first-time user: mode tabs, slot bar, 介入 panel (分断/停止/equivocation/遅延・欠落), シナリオ panel, rewind. Fix rough edges: e.g. the delay/drop message selector lists ALL messages ever (gets long — group by slot or cap with newest-first), equivocation legend is English ('equivocation') amid Japanese UI, panels may deserve collapsible <details> to keep the tree visible, empty-state hints where lists are empty. Add/extend DOM tests for whatever changes.

T-013 (phase5-polish, cost 2): verification gate — full typecheck/test/build plus GitHub Pages publish path check (vite.config base './' exists; verify dist/ opens standalone, document Pages deployment in README Development). Same batch as T-012 (same group, cost 6 ≤ 8).

After T-013: all 13 musts done -> the loop stops at the must boundary (must_complete_awaiting_phase_approval) for the human's phase decision; should Todos T-014..T-017 (autoplay, shortcuts, export, scenario notes) need --approve-should.
UI must keep consuming ONLY src/domain exports (tests/domain/purity.test.ts enforces). observe() defaults to instantDelivery — always pass session.delivery for local views.

Essence gates: (a) semantics changes of View/Vote/protocol skeleton and (b) large UI look/info-design pivots go back to the human (T-012 is polish, not a pivot — keep the existing information design). Discretionary semantics on record: reflection.jsonl cycle 6 decision entry (intervention semantics) + SLOTS_PER_EPOCH=4, lexicographic equivocation resolution, anchor slot 0 / first proposal slot 1, votes visible through s-1.

R-001 (proposed, non-blocking): human may enable real-browser verification via 'npx playwright install chromium' once; until then jsdom DOM tests are the autonomous verification layer. npm install needs --cache "$TMPDIR/npm-cache" under the sandbox. Heredoc-writing JSON with certain content trips the Bash guard — write state/tmp JSON files with the Write tool instead.
